name: British Grand Prix 2020
description: A masterclass in wet-to-dry transitions. Hamilton led from pole while nursing a puncture on the final lap to claim victory — a moment of sheer willpower.

name: Bahrain Grand Prix 2014
description: The greatest duel of the hybrid era. Hamilton and Rosberg traded fastest laps in a breathless finale that redefined teammate rivalry.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2021
description: The championship decided on the final lap of the final race. A moment that will be debated for generations — a lap that changed Formula 1 history.

name: Bahrain Grand Prix 2021
description: The first salvo in the greatest championship battle in a generation. Verstappen's raw pace against Hamilton's championship experience — the war begins.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 1995
description: Schumi at his rain-soaked, supernatural best. Threading a Ferrari through Eau Rouge at the limit while others lifted — this was pure dominance.

name: Japanese Grand Prix 2000
description: The moment Schumacher equalled Senna's three titles with Ferrari. An emotional, fist-pumping celebration that symbolised a generation's passing of the torch.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 1984
description: Perhaps the single greatest lap in Formula 1 history. Senna in a Toleman was pulling 10 seconds a lap faster than race leader Prost before the red flag fell.

name: Brazilian Grand Prix 1991
description: Senna crossed the line unable to lift his arms after driving the final laps with just one gear. Sheer grit and national pride fused into one iconic victory.

name: Italian Grand Prix 1985
description: The Professor at his smoothest. A tactical masterpiece at the temple of speed — Prost managing tyres, fuel, and rivals with cold precision to claim the title.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 1987
description: First grand prix in the Eastern Bloc. Prost navigated the tortuous Hungaroring circuit with surgical efficiency, reading the race five moves ahead.

name: Italian Grand Prix 1976
description: Six weeks after the inferno at the Nürburgring. Lauda returned, eyes bandaged, barely able to blink — and finished fourth. The most courageous drive in history.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 2006
description: Alonso in his championship-winning Renault, dancing through Monaco's streets. A display of qualifying perfection that echoed the ghosts of Senna.

name: Italian Grand Prix 2008
description: A Renault at the temple of speed. Alonso's victory in machinery not designed for Monza remains one of the most stunning drives of the modern era.

name: Brazilian Grand Prix 2012
description: Vettel won the championship despite a first-lap puncture and a recovery drive from last. Sixth place was enough. Three titles in three years — a dynasty complete.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 2011
description: Vettel on rails through Eau Rouge, Blanchimont, and the Pouhon in one of F1's most technically demanding circuits. Dominant from lights to flag.
